description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): list the caller's shares and read one by id (GET /api/v1/shares and GET /api/v1/shares/:id). A user token sees only its own shares and the projects it is a member of; another owner's share is 404, never 403. The list answers website.share@1 rows without tunnel tokens or captured bodies.
